title: Feeling Good Again Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Welcome to ‘Feeling Good Again’ a distinguished 8 bedroom vacation rental in Seaside, Florida. Known to many as the Vera Bradley Bed and Breakfast, this iconic home is a 30A landmark that sits steps away from the Seaside's famous town & beaches
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - 6 Bikes Included with Rental and 2 bikes for each guest cottage- Total 10 bikes when entire home booked - You will have a total of 18 RFID access cards for the main house for access to the private beaches in Seaside - 6 private parking spaces - HUGE rooftop to watch sunsets - STEPS to the Seaside square - Sandpiper Welcome Tote included for all rentals - ALL bedrooms have a TV and private full bath (not all baths are pictured as most on the second floor are identical) - Access to the Private Beaches in Seaside through the East Ruskin pavilions - Fully stocked kitchen - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: - There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. The cost for this cottage is $280/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. Welcome to ‘Feeling Good Again’ a distinguished eight-bedroom vacation rental in Seaside, Florida. Known to many as the Vera Bradley Bed and Breakfast, this iconic home is a 30A landmark that sits steps away from the town square and beaches made famous by The Truman Show. **The 2-bedroom guest cottage can be rented with the main house or separately. Please note the pricing quoted is for the main 8 bedroom home only. Please inquire for additional pricing on the guest house.** Remarkable in nature, ‘Feeling Good Again’ perfectly pairs classic Seaside style with awe-inspiring architectural elements. The home redefines “southern charm” with its two-story veranda, tuscan columns, gardens, and rooftop deck which offers unparalleled views of the Gulf of America. The property’s exterior beauty is only eclipsed by the grand nature of the interior. Enjoy chic, coastal décor and antique touches that make you feel right at home. Bright, open, and spacious, the living room offers plenty of seating for everyone and connects seamlessly to the kitchen and dining areas. The dining room table has enough room for six, with a nearby breakfast bar adding space for four more. The picture-perfect, Thermador Range featured kitchen comes complete with the most up-to-date appliances, a farmhouse style sink, and an abundance of counter and cabinet space. The home spans over 5,500 square-feet, offering sleeping arrangements for 18 guests in the main house. Up to an additional 4 guests, if adding the two carriage houses. Soak in the town’s rich history and renowned beaches from the comforts of “home.” Should you decide to venture out, a world of boutique shops, vintage food trucks, award-winning eateries, and concerts are at your fingertips and right outside your door. ACCOMMODATIONS: [Sleeps 18 - main house.](Please note most of the en-suite bathrooms are identical, so not all bathrooms are pictured in the listing.) Main House First Floor: - Guest Bedroom1: King Bed, Private Bath, Bar - Guest Bedroom 2: Queen Bed, Private Bath (Handicap Accessible), Bar Main House Second Floor: - Guest Bedroom 3: King Bed, Private Bath, Bar - Guest Bedroom 4: Queen Bed, Private Bath, Bar - Guest Bedroom 5: Queen Bed, Private Bath, Bar - Guest Bedroom 6: King Bed, Private Bath, Bar - Guest Bedroom 7: Twin-over-Queen Bunk Bed with Twin Trundle, Private bath Main House Third Floor: - Guest Bedroom 8: Three Twin Beds, Private Bath Rented separately or together: [Sleeps 4 - carriage houses.] Guest House First Floor: - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bath, Kitchenette Guest House Second Floor: - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bath, Kitchenette. Pull out couch available upon request. ** 2 Parking Spots on Seaside Avenue + additional private side parking for up to 4 -5 more cars, depending on car size ** The main home is 8 bedrooms, sleeping 18 with 3 king suites, 3 queen suites, bunk room for 3 and a third floor teen suite with 3 twin beds. 2 additional king guest suites located in a separate guest cottage can be added for an additional fee. Please inquire with Sandpiper Vacation Rentals for pricing. Free WiFi

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
